workItems.instructions: Review the company and its requested initial skill.
Submit a fictional insurance demo pack. Never enter real tax, banking or identity numbers.
Submit a fictional financial demo pack. Never enter real tax, banking or identity numbers.
Submit a fictional agreement demo pack. Never enter real tax, banking or identity numbers.
Submit fictional license evidence for HVAC.
Review insurance evidence v1 using the simulated verifier.
Review financial evidence v1 using the simulated verifier.
Review agreement evidence v1 using the simulated verifier.
Provision a fictional vendor after all three administrative approvals.
Verify the latest demo license. An expired result requires replacement; a timeout is retryable.
Decide whether to approve HVAC after license verification.
Confirm the fictional portal profile is configured. No real account is created.
Complete the demo induction: safety basics, job acceptance and network standards.
Confirm completion of the contractor’s initial induction.
Publish initial activation after readiness is satisfied. This cannot remove a suspension.
